analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: The objective is to modernize the MagicBox codebase by grounding the development process in the existing real MagicBox controllers, specifically addressing the seed_ra fix.

Explicit error handling and observability requirements must be defined.
Measurable non-functional requirements should be included.

Implement React 18 + Next.js 14 for the frontend.

Are there any additional compliance requirements not listed?

executive_summary: This project aims to modernize the MagicBox platform by leveraging existing controllers and addressing the seed_ra fix, ensuring improved performance, maintainability, and scalability.

functional_requirements.title: Preserve Existing Controller Functionality
functional_requirements.description: Ensure all existing functionalities of MagicBox controllers are preserved during the modernization.
acceptance_criteria: All existing controller endpoints return expected results.
Legacy data processing logic is preserved.
No regression in current business workflows.

functional_requirements.title: Integrate seed_ra Fix
functional_requirements.description: Implement the seed_ra fix within the modernized codebase to address existing issues.
acceptance_criteria: The seed_ra fix is applied to all relevant controllers.
No new errors introduced by the seed_ra fix.
All tests related to seed_ra pass successfully.

functional_requirements.title: Implement .NET 8 Architecture
functional_requirements.description: Migrate the existing PHP codebase to a .NET 8 architecture.
acceptance_criteria: All controllers are rewritten in .NET 8.
The application runs successfully on ASP.NET Core.
No performance degradation compared to the PHP version.

functional_requirements.title: Use Entity Framework Core
functional_requirements.description: Utilize Entity Framework Core for database operations.
acceptance_criteria: All database interactions are handled via Entity Framework Core.
Data integrity is maintained post-migration.
Performance benchmarks meet or exceed current levels.

functional_requirements.title: Frontend Modernization with React
functional_requirements.description: Modernize the frontend using React 18 and Next.js 14.
acceptance_criteria: All UI components are implemented in React.
The application is fully functional in major browsers.
User experience is consistent with existing design.

functional_requirements.title: PostgreSQL 16 Compatibility
functional_requirements.description: Ensure the application is compatible with PostgreSQL 16.
acceptance_criteria: All database queries run successfully on PostgreSQL 16.

non_functional_requirements.title: Performance Optimization
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure the modernized application performs efficiently under expected load.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Response time under 200ms for 95% of requests.
acceptance_criteria: Load test shows response time under 200ms for 95% of requests.

non_functional_requirements.title: Reliability

blocking.question: Target application architecture for the modernization
blocking.default_recommendation: Start with a modular monolith unless there is a clear reason to decompose immediately.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Early coupling / drift that is expensive to correct downstream.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Authentication / authorization strategy for the modern target
blocking.default_recommendation: Model current auth behavior first, then move to a clearer standards-based target with explicit compatibility rules.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Authorization regressions and lost session context during cutover.

blocking.question: Confirm identity/access model (role model, multi-user assumptions, and credential handling).
blocking.default_recommendation: Define target role model and credential policy before implementation.

blocking.question: Are there existing operational constraints or integration dependencies not listed?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

blocking.default_recommendation: Regenerate BDD from validated golden flows, route evidence, and SQL touchpoints before Build starts.

non_blocking.default_recommendation: OpenTelemetry + structured logs for parity troubleshooting.
